## Interactive apps

::: theme-grid
::: {.theme-card .body}
### Rapa Nui spatial point patterns
Explore how *Pocillopora* colonies are spread across three Rapa Nui reef sites along a wave-exposure gradient, using large-area-imaging orthomosaics. Includes Clark–Evans, quadrat tests of complete spatial randomness, Ripley's K/L and pair-correlation envelopes in R/spatstat via Shinylive. Built as an SCCS-NY teaching app.

[Open the app](https://jjherlan.github.io/rpn-spatial/) · [Code](https://github.com/jjherlan/rpn-spatial)
:::
::: {.theme-card .body}
### Jamaica Bay wind data
An interactive look at wind records from the EcoAirML sensor station at a Jamaica Bay salt marsh restoration site.

[Open the app](https://jjherlan.github.io/jamaica_bay_wind_data/) · [Code](https://github.com/jjherlan/jamaica_bay_wind_data)
:::
:::

## Methods I work with

::: two-col
::: {}
**Imaging and photogrammetry**\
Large-area imaging, Structure-from-Motion (Agisoft Metashape), Viscore, TagLab, CoralNet

**Spatial statistics**\
Spatial point pattern analysis, generalized linear, additive and mixed models, bootstrapping, time series analysis
:::
::: {}
**Machine learning**\
Random Forest, Extra Trees, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, neural networks, LSTM, LightGBM, ensemble species distribution models

**Languages and platforms**\
R, Python, Quarto, Shiny/Shinylive, [marimo](https://marimo.io/) notebooks, ArcGIS Pro
:::
:::
